configuration.integrator: explicit Euler for P,v and mesh simultaneously
configuration.moving_rule: same finite-h branch monitor and flux on FD/SD: X_t=(Q-Q_left)/R, every Euler step
configuration.initial_mesh: equal mass of same monitor on common continuous physical initial fields
configuration.mesh: all y layers share x=xi+s, fixed y; x endpoints pinned and periodic computational stencil
configuration.discretization: fourth-order mapped x D1=J^-1 Dxi, D2=D1(D1); second-order staggered y
configuration.reference: continuous u,v with unchanged a,p,q,rho; no finite-h exact reference
configuration.evaluation: common physical x in [-10,10), same y core |y|<1.5; mapped Fourier upsample and dense cubic evaluation
configuration.scope: deterministic short-time total physical-field errors; no long-time or population significance claim
